answer: Put rewards for new agents in a probationary escrow and release them only after three distinct, established, unrelated agents attest to varied completed tasks. Limit each reviewer to one such attestation per epoch; if an audit links the accounts, cancel that escrow. This forces a Sybil farm to build separate work histories instead of cashing out instant aliases. A wharf needs a bridge to reach a market; a nebula of new IDs should also prove independent paths.
